newsitem.title: USA: Three Mass. fishermen drown when trawler overturns.
newsitem.headline: Three Mass. fishermen drown when trawler overturns.

text.p: Three fishermen drowned Thursday when their vessel capsized off the Massachusetts coast, Coast Guard officials said.

The 45-foot trawler Heather Lynn II, based in Newburyport, Massachusetts, was reported to have capsized after it passed between a tug boat and the barge it was towing 10 miles off the coast near Gloucester, the officials said.

Coast Guard divers recovered the bodies of the three crew members of the trawler and a Coast Guard helicopter flew them to the Boston Medical Centre. "They were dead on arrival," said a spokeswoman for the medical centre who declined to identify the men until relatives had been notified.
